title: Krabi: a 3D map instead of the roadside stop
kaylee: Krabi opens on a toy map of Krabi and Phang Nga Bay floating in the sky. She sends the little pink songthaew to the elephants or the boat, comes back to the map after each one (its stamp lands there), then the plane takes off from Krabi airport to fly home.
questions: Which one should be the next real place on the map: Ao Nang or Koh Lanta? (Both are already on the board as toys she can poke.)
Do the elephant and the longtail floating over the two places feel right, or is that too much?
